deviations: First-stage F reported as an R translation of ivreg2's Kleibergen-Paap rk Wald F for one endogenous regressor and one excluded instrument: first-stage Wald statistic on msuit26mean with the unadjusted cluster (county_id) VCE, scaled by (N-K)/N*(G-1)/G. The squared cluster t-statistic with Stata's small-sample adjustment is printed as a diagnostic (not a RESULT).
notes: Followed main.do and Tables.do (Tables 2 and 3). Loaded replication_data.dta; built county_id from GAZ_CNTY, mills_pc and wrights_pc = count/pcmean, wheat_suit = wheat_tmean<=5, riv_rug26count/1000, msuit26mean = wheat_suit*riv_rug26count. Table 2 cols 1-5 and Table 3 col 5 are OLS via fixest::feols with SEs clustered by county_id (min_dist* = min_dist_to_roman_rds, min_dist_2nav_rivers). Table 3 cols 2/4/6 are 2SLS via feols, instrumenting mills_pc with msuit26mean. N = 298 in every column, with 35 clusters. One run only. After it, I compared the RESULT values with the claims using check_attempt, which reported all claims within tolerance, so the script was not changed and no claim attempt is recorded.
